root_causes: The Codex Desktop process did not inherit the ambient write-tool opt-in, so only read tools were exposed.
A stale ready handoff was treated as live and prevented Runtime recovery.
Multiple MCP adapter connections could compete to supervise and remove the same Runtime handoff.
A retained existing-handoff IPC connection could monopolize the Runtime single-client server.
claim_boundary: This failed attempt proves only that Codex Desktop loaded the development MCP adapter. It does not prove a Ready Runtime, write-tool activation, project creation, or MCP010A completion.
